correctness.rationale: Dividing BPF recurrence gives u_{i+1}-2cos(s)u_i+u_{i-1}=h² f_i/Theta; kernel exp(-is|i-j|) has defect -2i sin s and satisfies impedance edges. Thus Green matrix exact and each entry modulus h²/(2Theta sin s), so Frobenius norm m h²/(2Theta sin s). Near s=pi, diagonal conjugation reduces K_m to exp(i delta |i-j|) near all-ones J; isolated singular value m. Second-order perturbation of KK* gives lambda2=-(m²-1)(2m²+7)/45 and norm curvature (m²-1)(2m²+7)/(90 m²). Scalar limit delta*k*norm ->2L(1-1/n)/pi. Independent rational sums checked m1..24 and 50 direct boundary system inversions; no n-uniform error estimate claimed.
residual_risks: Direct primary BPF and KMS full text were not obtained; specialist Green-kernel expansions could imply the exact coefficient.
